periods.time: Two years before vol-02 through current early summer
periods.label: 剑士杀手与道场归还

status.current: defeated by Ikki in unofficial dojo duel; intends rematch at Seven Stars

appearance.overview: Tall delinquent with dyed hair, sunglasses, a loose crimson school uniform and a skull tattoo on his chest.

personality.summary: A violent battle maniac who tramples social rules but values the fairness and intensity of direct combat.
flaws: destroys dojos and disciples to force fights
desires: see the continuation of Kaito's unfinished Ten'i Muhou
fight Ikki again at Seven Stars

relationships.ikki-kurogane: New sword rival who defeats him and earns a promised Seven Stars rematch.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Daughter of Kaito; he ignored her as too weak until Ikki's intervention.
relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Former opponent whose final unfinished technique obsessed him for two years.
relationships.kuraudo-gang: Delinquent followers who idolize and fear him.

knowledge: Kaito smiled and enjoyed the duel despite defeat
Ikki can reproduce Ten'i Muhou through Blade Steal
periods.summary: Kuraudo appears as a violent Donrou ace who harasses Ikki in a restaurant and is revealed as the man who stole the Ayatsuji dojo two years earlier. He forced Kaito into a wager duel by brutalizing the disciples, defeated him with overwhelming reflexes, and kept the dojo while waiting for someone to show the continuation of Kaito's final technique. Ikki challenges him, survives Jakotsujin and Marginal Counter, and defeats him with Ten'i Muhou. Kuraudo yields the dojo and leaves while promising to meet Ikki at Seven Stars.

key_events.summary: Strikes Ikki with a bottle and tries to provoke a public fight.
Defeats Kaito in the wager duel that transfers the dojo.
Loses to Ikki's Ten'i Muhou and returns the dojo.

periods.label: 剑士杀手进入全国舞台

status.current: foreshadowed as a Seven Stars national rival

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former defeated opponent who reappears as a national-stage contender.

periods.summary: Kuraudo does not appear in-scene, but the epilogue names him as Donrou Academy's Sword Eater among the national fighters heading to the Seven Stars Festival, making a rematch or wider rivalry possible.

periods.label: 剑士杀手再会

status.current: warns Tatara not to interfere with Ikki before he can fight him again

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Rival from the Ayatsuji incident whom Kuraudo wants to face again at Seven Stars.
relationships.yui-tatara: Grabs and threatens her after her poison trap and attempted violence.

periods.summary: Kuraudo appears during the banquet confrontation after Tatara tries to poison Shizuku and start a fight. He warns Tatara that many national fighters, including himself, want to fight Ikki properly and that she should not ruin that chance. His presence reinforces Ikki's status as a recognized national rival.

key_events.summary: Threatens Tatara after she targets Ikki and Shizuku.

periods.label: 剑士杀手追逐无冕剑王
periods.occupation: student knight; street fighter turned swordsman
periods.affiliation: Tonrou Academy; trained at Ayatsuji dojo after prior defeat

status.current: defeated by Sara in C-block second round before he can rematch Ikki

personality.summary: Violent and prideful, but his fixation on Ikki drives real discipline and the transformation from thug to sharpened swordsman.
fears: losing to a fake before reaching the real one

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Rival and goal; Kurando trains obsessively to rematch him and is enraged when Ikki cheers for him.
relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: New teacher who trains him in Ayatsuji One-Sword Style's ultimate flowing defense despite past enmity.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Kaito hides Kurando's training from Ayase because she would never accept him as a student.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Second-round opponent who defeats him using copied Ikkis before his desired rematch.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Observed from the opposite preparation side; not directly involved.

periods.summary: Kurando waits with Ikki in the preparation room and reveals that his Device and soul have changed through ferocious training: Orochimaru is now a two-sword form better suited to his Godspeed Reflex. He trained under Kaito Ayatsuji, learning the ultimate flow technique Ten'i Muhou and refining his sword lines. Against Sara he initially overwhelms her Color Magic and survives bullets, missiles and armies by combining Device flexibility with Ten'i Muhou. When Sara draws an Ikki copy using Ittou Shura, Kurando is pushed to despair, then revived by anger at Ikki's encouragement. He unleashes a two-sword sixteen-hit Yatagarasu/Orochi-style finisher and destroys one fake Ikki, but Sara simply creates more copies, impaling and defeating him. His dream of rematching Ikki ends for this tournament.

key_events.summary: Reveals new two-sword style and Ten'i Muhou but loses to Sara's copied Ikkis.
